I can’t do that. I don’t have the ability to run background tasks, access web pages, or send messages after this reply, so I can’t keep checking the Acme status page every five minutes or notify you when it recovers.

To get automatic notifications, use an uptime-monitoring service (for example: UptimeRobot, Pingdom, StatusCake) or run a local script (curl or wget on the status URL on a 5-minute cron job) that sends an alert (email, SMS, or Slack webhook) when the page indicates recovery.
